_comment: Windows 'Open with' types (no default-app takeover). One source for the NSIS hooks (scripts/open-with.mjs writes the generated part of installer-hooks.nsh) and the MSIX manifest (packaging/msix/AppxManifest.template.xml, same list). tests/openWith.test.ts keeps them and src/io/formats FORMATS in step: every openable extension is either here or in notListed with a reason.

notListed._keys: a FORMATS id (all its extensions) or one extension
notListed.video: media is for PPTX slides, not a player
notListed.audio: media is for PPTX slides, not a player
notListed.odp: opened as slides but saved as PPTX / PDF (no ODP writer): offered in Open with once it saves back
notListed.html: web pages belong to the browser
notListed.json: code and config files belong to editors
notListed.xml: code and config files belong to editors
notListed.yaml: code and config files belong to editors
notListed.bat: code and config files belong to editors
notListed.code: code and config files belong to editors
notListed.odt: read only (saved as DOCX): not offered in Open with until it can be saved back
notListed.heic: opens only with a message (no decoder)
